_meta.title: Claude Code plugin recommendations — stack signal → plugin map
_meta.notes: Curated third-party Claude Code plugins worth surfacing per project. ai-kit recommends, never bundles. Install entries are advisory — users run /plugin install themselves. Mirror of mcp-servers.json schema with additional 'marketplace' + 'install' fields.

recommendations.name: claude-mem
recommendations.best_for: Long-running projects where Claude should remember decisions, context, and history across sessions
recommendations.value: Persistent cross-session memory — complements ai-kit's /ai:checkpoint with searchable long-term context.

recommendations.name: tdd-guard
recommendations.best_for: Projects with a real test suite where you want hook-enforced red-green-refactor discipline
recommendations.value: Real-time TDD enforcement via hooks — pairs with ai-kit's /ai:tdd skill for the workflow + guard for the gate.

recommendations.name: ask-questions-if-underspecified
recommendations.best_for: Any project — forces clarifying questions when a request is ambiguous
recommendations.value: Codifies the same intent as ai-kit's grill-first rule + /ai:grill-with-docs skill; the plugin enforces it via behaviour, the rule enforces it via prompt.

recommendations.name: claude-md-management
recommendations.best_for: Projects with a CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md that drifts from reality
recommendations.value: Keeps CLAUDE.md hygiene automated — section linting, deprecated-instruction detection, regeneration suggestions.

recommendations.name: skill-creator
recommendations.best_for: Users extending ai-kit with their own skills
recommendations.value: Skill scaffolding + eval + benchmarking. Use it to author the project-local skills ai-kit suggests but does not ship.

recommendations.name: github
recommendations.best_for: Projects hosted on GitHub — issue/PR/workflow integration
recommendations.value: Native gh-aware skills for issue triage, PR review, workflow inspection. Complements ai-kit's /ai:to-issues and /ai:ship.

recommendations.name: laravel-boost
recommendations.best_for: Laravel projects
recommendations.value: Eloquent / Artisan / Filament / queue idioms baked into the agent. Pairs with ai-kit's stack-agnostic skills.

recommendations.name: frontend-design
recommendations.best_for: Frontend projects needing layout / typography / component design help
recommendations.value: Design-aware suggestions, component sketches, layout critique. Complements ai-kit's /ai:prototype and /ai:qa.

recommendations.name: lazyweb
recommendations.best_for: Frontend projects where design research and screenshot reference compounds value
recommendations.value: Screenshot database + design research workflows — pairs with frontend-design for the search + critique loop.

recommendations.name: ui-ux-pro-max
recommendations.best_for: Frontend projects wanting a reasoned design system — priority-ranked, domain-queryable rules for styles, palettes, type pairings, UX guidelines, and charts
recommendations.value: Searchable design-rule database with priority-based, --domain-queryable recommendations + shadcn MCP. Goes beyond frontend-design's critique into structured token/pattern output. Single-source — surfaced, never default. Note: upstream count claims drift across its own manifests (styles 50+ vs 67, stacks 10 vs 15); capability verified on disk, specific counts treated as advisory.

recommendations.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
recommendations.best_for: Web apps needing in-browser debugging (console, network, DOM inspection)
recommendations.value: Direct Chrome devtools access from Claude — complements ai-kit's /ai:qa for live debugging.

recommendations.name: typescript-lsp
recommendations.best_for: TypeScript projects — adds language-server-aware code intelligence
recommendations.value: Type-aware navigation, refactoring, and diagnostics from the LSP instead of grep-and-guess.

recommendations.name: php-lsp
recommendations.best_for: PHP / Laravel projects — adds language-server-aware code intelligence
recommendations.value: Type-aware navigation and refactoring through the PHP LSP — useful in any non-trivial PHP codebase.

recommendations.name: context7
recommendations.best_for: Projects where library docs change faster than your training data
recommendations.value: Live library docs lookup (MCP server) — pairs with the canonical context7 rule in standards/rules/.

recommendations.name: claude-code-setup
recommendations.best_for: Users setting up Claude Code automation (hooks, subagents, skills, MCP) on a new project
recommendations.value: General-purpose automation recommender — complementary to ai-kit's /ai:setup and /ai:recommend-tools.

recommendations.name: resend
recommendations.best_for: Projects sending transactional or marketing email through Resend
recommendations.value: Skills for the Resend API, CLI, React Email templates and deliverability — carries the gotchas (idempotency keys, webhook signature verification, template variable syntax) that otherwise fail silently in production.

recommendations.name: caveman
recommendations.best_for: Long sessions where token-economy matters — ultra-compressed communication + subagent-output compression
recommendations.value: ~60-75% token savings on chatty surfaces. Complementary to ai-kit's verbose skills.

recommendations.name: ponytail
recommendations.best_for: Any project where the agent over-builds — YAGNI ladder enforced before code is written
recommendations.value: ~54% less code on over-build-prone tasks (upstream benchmark). Orthogonal to caveman: caveman compresses prose, ponytail constrains code. Safety, validation and error handling are never cut.

recommendations.name: diagram-design
recommendations.best_for: Projects that already draw diagrams in markdown (Mermaid blocks present) and want publication-quality exports — blog posts, decks, client docs
recommendations.value: 39 editorial diagram types as self-contained HTML+SVG, brand-matched from your site; redraws existing Mermaid/draw.io sources at a chosen format, size, and detail level. Note: output is standalone HTML — GitHub does not render it inline, so keep Mermaid as the in-repo source of truth and use this as the renderer for exported visuals. Marketplace add first: /plugin marketplace add cathrynlavery/diagram-design.

recommendations.name: web-quality-skills
recommendations.best_for: User-facing web apps that ship to real users — measured performance, Core Web Vitals, WCAG 2.2, SEO and best-practices audits against a running page
recommendations.value: Six measurement-first skills (web-quality-audit, performance, core-web-vitals, accessibility, seo, best-practices) that run live Lighthouse / Chrome DevTools audits and separate field (CrUX/RUM) from lab evidence, instead of emitting static advice. Fills the one frontend gap in the kit: a11y.mini.md prescribes axe-core in E2E, but nothing in ai-kit covers LCP/INP/CLS or field-vs-lab measurement. Uses the already-catalogued chrome-devtools-mcp as its measurement backend and complements /ai:qa, which smoke-tests function rather than quality. Marketplace add first: /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/web-quality-skills.
